overview: The Floating Stone Forest is the most iconic zone in Mons Letalis.
details: Massive boulders drift like trees, held aloft by geomantic fractures. Rockhoppers leap between shelves while stone sentinels patrol levitation groves.
hooks: A levitation grove destabilizes, dropping dozens of floating stones.
Stone sentinels gather near a geomantic pulse.
A gravity flicker reveals a hidden cavern.
